The new filing pushes Cascade’s total spend on Republic Services stock since Aug. 25 to roughly $424.8 million across 25 separate open-market purchases, spanning 1.92 million shares, at prices ranging from about $220 to $224 a share.

Because Cascade already owns more than 10% of Republic Services, it is required to disclose its trades within days rather than waiting for a quarterly 13F, giving an unusually granular look at how aggressively Gates has been buying.

Gates has held a position in Republic Services since 2008, making it one of Cascade’s longest-running concentrated holdings outside of his stake in Berkshire Hathaway.

After the latest round of buying, Cascade now holds an estimated 115 million shares of the company — a stake that underscores just how central the trash and recycling giant has become to Gates’s personal portfolio.
